PyTorch’s `Embedding(padding_idx=0)` freezes the padding embedding, initially zero; it does not mask recurrent updates. From the documented GRU equations, zero inputs can still change hidden states through biases and recurrent terms. Consequently, ordinary GRU execution over leading zeros need not equal replaying only real items. Omitting `h_0` initializes each forward call with zeros; independent histories should not inherit another user’s hidden state. `eval()` does not reset explicitly carried state. [Embedding documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.Embedding), [GRU documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.GRU.html).

`pack_padded_sequence` retains each sequence’s leading `length` positions, requiring valid tokens before trailing padding. Directly packing left-padded histories would retain padding and truncate real items. For padding-free replay, compact real items in chronological order, right-pad internally, then pack with CPU lengths and `enforce_sorted=False`; handle empty histories separately. If `log2feats` requires left-aligned padding positions, restore outputs to their original positions. Read the final nonpadding position in that representation, never `count-1`. [Packing documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence.html), [unpacking example](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence.html).

These are library semantics, not findings about the supplied host implementation. Check its recurrence, masking, initial state, readout and predictor writer before changing behavior. Suggested evaluation tests: compare a history alone versus in differently padded batches; compare packed execution with unpadded replay; verify batch-order independence and repeated-call consistency; compare training-side and exported-predictor scores. Padding invariance is expected only when padding updates are intentionally skipped; a baseline that processes leading zeros must be reproduced consistently or deliberately changed in both training and inference.
